title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Sunday, 25 October 2026
description: DeepSeek closes a $15-16 billion funding round backed by Tencent and CATL, Western Sydney's new international airport opens today, Queensland relaxes fish passage rules for waterway construction, and Chaz Mostert wins a wet Gold Coast 500 opener. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.
